dict.string: Brim reads Music or Spotify artwork and controls their playback when you allow it.
Brim reads your calendar on this Mac to show your next event in the island. Nothing is stored or sent anywhere.

Brim shows downloads that are still arriving in your Downloads folder as a progress ring in the island. It only looks at file names and sizes, and nothing leaves your Mac.
Brim can hide the island while a Focus is on. It only learns whether a Focus is active, never which one or why.
Brim captures window thumbnails for the switcher and a temporary desktop image for the optional lid-closing fold effect.
